# AI in HVAC

> Best AI for HVAC techs, by job: answers from your own unit history, live readings, manuals or a free chatbot. 14 tools compared, with sources and prices.

Published by Kenner Systems Inc. (https://getkenner.com/), which makes one of the tools compared. Vendor facts checked on 10 November 2026.

## The short answer

For a commercial HVAC or refrigeration service team, the best AI is one that builds a knowledge base from your own units and past jobs, answers from it by message or phone call, and writes the report afterwards: that is what Kenner does, and we make it. If your shop runs on ServiceTitan, BuildOps or ServiceTrade, start with the AI already in it. For manuals and model-specific troubleshooting, Bluon and FixBot Pro answer from the literature. For a single technician, measureQuick, HVAC/R AI Pro, the manufacturers' free apps and ChatGPT cover a lot, as long as the answer is checked against the manual.

- Commercial HVAC/R service teams: Kenner (https://getkenner.com/)
- Shops that run on ServiceTitan: ServiceTitan Atlas (https://www.servicetitan.com/features/atlas)
- Model-specific troubleshooting across brands: Bluon MasterMechanic (https://www.bluon.com/)
- Diagnosing from live measurements: measureQuick mQ Assist (https://measurequick.com/ai-assist/)
- Documenting the job and the equipment: XOi (https://xoi.io/)
- Commercial contractors on BuildOps: BuildOps OpsAI (https://buildops.com/platform/opsai)
- Commercial service contractors on ServiceTrade: ServiceTrade Smart Assistants (https://servicetrade.com/products/servicetrade-platform/features/smart-assistants/)
- A single technician who wants a dedicated app: HVAC/R AI Pro (https://hvacrai.com/)
- Answers cited from the service manual: FixBot Pro (https://fixbot.pro/hvac)
- Copeland compressors and refrigeration: Copeland Mobile with Scout AI (https://www.copeland.com/en-us/tools-resources/mobile-apps/copeland-mobile)
- Trane and American Standard dealers: Trane Tech Assistant (https://partners.trane.com/diagnostics-premium)
- Lennox equipment, by text message: Lennox Technical Support AI agent (https://www.lennoxpros.com/partner-resources/support)
- Carrier equipment: Carrier Service Technician app (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/carrier-service-technician/id1123086541)
- General questions, at no cost: ChatGPT (https://chatgpt.com/)
